story_description: Create the foundational data model and types for representing hook execution events in a timeline/Gantt chart format, enabling visualization of hook lifecycles with proper temporal relationships and hierarchical structure.
task_description: Create the GanttBar SwiftUI view component that renders an individual animated timeline bar representing a hook execution event, with proper width calculation based on duration, color coding by category, status indicators, and smooth animations for running state.
atom_description: Implement the GanttBar SwiftUI view that displays a horizontal bar representing a hook execution event. The bar width is proportional to event duration relative to total timeline span. Bar color is derived from HookTimelineCategory. Running events display a pulsing animation. Completed events show solid fill. Failed events show red tint with error icon. Bar supports hover state for tooltip trigger and tap for selection.
problem_statement: The Gantt visualization requires individual bar components that visually represent hook execution events on a timeline. Users need to see at a glance: how long each hook took (bar width), what type of hook it was (color), whether it succeeded or failed (status indicator), and which hooks are currently running (animation). Without a dedicated GanttBar component, the timeline would be static and uninformative.

functional_requirements: FR1: GanttBar shall accept HookTimelineEvent, totalDuration (TimeInterval), availableWidth (CGFloat), isSelected (Bool), onSelect ((UUID) -> Void), and onHover ((Bool) -> Void) as parameters
FR2: GanttBar shall calculate bar width as (event.duration ?? 0) / totalDuration * availableWidth clamped to minimum 20 points and maximum availableWidth
FR3: GanttBar shall display horizontal rectangle with height of 24 points and corner radius of 4 points
FR4: GanttBar shall fill rectangle with color from event.category.color
FR5: GanttBar shall overlay status icon on right edge of bar using SF Symbol from event.status.iconName
FR6: GanttBar shall display event.name as label text left-aligned within bar, truncated with ellipsis if exceeds available space
FR7: GanttBar shall apply pulsing opacity animation (0.6 to 1.0) when event.status is running
FR8: GanttBar shall apply red tint overlay when event.status is failed
FR9: GanttBar shall highlight with accent border when isSelected is true
FR10: GanttBar shall call onHover callback with true when mouse enters and false when mouse exits
FR11: GanttBar shall call onSelect callback with event.id when bar is tapped
nonfunctional_requirements: NFR1: GanttBar body shall compute in under 1 millisecond excluding animation frames
NFR2: Animation frame rate shall maintain 60fps during pulsing effect
NFR3: Memory footprint per GanttBar instance shall not exceed 500 bytes excluding event reference
NFR4: GanttBar shall render correctly in both light and dark appearance modes
NFR5: GanttBar tap target shall be minimum 24x24 points for accessibility compliance
implementation_steps: Step 1: Create new file GanttBar.swift in Blaze/Sources/UI/Hooks/ directory
Step 2: Import SwiftUI and define GanttBar struct conforming to View
Step 3: Add stored properties: event (HookTimelineEvent), totalDuration (TimeInterval), availableWidth (CGFloat), isSelected (Bool), onSelect ((UUID) -> Void), onHover ((Bool) -> Void)
Step 4: Add private computed property barWidth: CGFloat that calculates width as max(20, min(availableWidth, (event.duration ?? 0) / totalDuration * availableWidth))
Step 5: Add private State property isHovered (Bool) for tracking hover state
Step 6: Add private State property animationActive (Bool) for controlling pulsing animation
Step 7: Implement body property returning RoundedRectangle with fill color from event.category.color
Step 8: Add frame modifier with width barWidth and height 24
Step 9: Add overlay with HStack containing Text(event.name) left-aligned and Image(systemName: event.status.iconName) right-aligned
Step 10: Add opacity modifier that returns animationActive ? 0.6 : 1.0 with animation when status is running
Step 11: Add onAppear modifier that sets animationActive to true with repeatForever animation if status is running
Step 12: Add onChange modifier for event.status that stops animation when status changes from running
Step 13: Add overlay with RoundedRectangle stroke using accent color when isSelected is true
Step 14: Add overlay with Color.red.opacity(0.3) when event.status is failed
Step 15: Add onHover modifier that updates isHovered state and calls onHover callback
Step 16: Add onTapGesture modifier that calls onSelect with event.id
Step 17: Add accessibility modifiers: accessibilityLabel, accessibilityValue, accessibilityHint
Step 18: Write preview provider with sample HookTimelineEvent data showing all status states

ui_states: Default state: solid color bar with category color, no border, full opacity
Hover state: same as default (hover triggers tooltip via callback, not visual change on bar itself)
Selected state: default appearance plus 2pt accent color border stroke
Running state: pulsing opacity animation between 0.6 and 1.0
Failed state: red tint overlay at 30% opacity plus default appearance
Cancelled state: reduced opacity at 50% plus strikethrough effect on label
ui_interactions: Tap on bar triggers onSelect callback with event UUID for selection handling
Mouse hover triggers onHover(true) callback on enter, onHover(false) on exit
VoiceOver activation triggers onSelect callback same as tap
ui_copy: Accessibility label: Hook execution bar for {event.name}
Accessibility hint: Double tap to view details
edge_cases: Edge case 1: event.duration is nil (running event with no end time) - use 0 for calculation, resulting in minimum width bar
Edge case 2: totalDuration is 0 (single instant event) - guard against division by zero, return minimum width
Edge case 3: availableWidth is less than minimum 20 points - clamp to availableWidth even if below minimum
Edge case 4: event.name is empty string - display no label text, bar remains visible
Edge case 5: event.name exceeds bar width significantly - truncate with ellipsis, show full name in tooltip
Edge case 6: Status changes from running to completed while animation active - cancel animation, set opacity to 1.0
Edge case 7: Multiple rapid status changes - debounce animation state changes to prevent flicker
Edge case 8: Very long duration event (hours) - bar fills entire available width, label may overflow
failure_modes: FM1: Animation fails to start due to SwiftUI state timing - use onAppear with slight delay (0.1s) as workaround
FM2: Category color returns nil - provide fallback Color.gray in bar fill
FM3: Status icon name invalid - SF Symbols returns placeholder, acceptable degraded state
FM4: onSelect callback throws - wrap in Task to prevent view crash
FM5: Memory leak from retained animation closure - use weak self pattern in animation completion if needed
rollback_plan: Delete Blaze/Sources/UI/Hooks/GanttBar.swift. No other files are modified as this is an additive component. Parent views (G005-ROW) can render placeholder or fallback to text list until GanttBar is reimplemented.

risks: Risk 1: Animation performance may degrade with many running bars rendered simultaneously
Risk 2: Width calculation edge cases (zero duration, zero totalDuration) could cause visual glitches
Risk 3: Color accessibility may be insufficient for color-blind users relying only on category color
mitigations: Mitigation 1: Use explicit animation on opacity only, not on entire view hierarchy. Consider pausing off-screen animations.
Mitigation 2: Guard against division by zero in barWidth calculation. Clamp to minimum width.
Mitigation 3: Always pair category color with status icon. Add pattern overlay option in future accessibility settings.
risk_register.blast_radius: Low - GanttBar is a leaf component. Failure affects only Gantt visualization, not core hook execution or other settings views.
risk_register.fallback_plan: If GanttBar has critical issues, GanttRow can render simple Rectangle placeholders or fall back to text-based event list until bar component is fixed.
